name: Double Wave
description: 👋👋 lives in the reaction-coded space — the two emojis together make the share-coded moment explicit. The read depends on context, but the register itself does not.

Most platforms render the two emojis side by side, but the read does not change with spacing.

faqs.question: Can 👋👋 be sincere?
faqs.answer: Yes — reaction-coded combos can be sincere when paired with a warm partner emoji. The read depends on context.

faqs.question: What does 👋👋 mean from a stranger?
faqs.answer: From a stranger 👋👋 usually reads as a public-coded reaction. The combo is the same on comment sections regardless of relationship.

faqs.question: Should I send 👋👋 to my boss?
faqs.answer: Do not lead with 👋👋 to a boss. Reaction-coded emojis are easy to misread upward; prefer sentences or single soft emojis.

faqs.question: Should I use 👋👋 for small things?
faqs.answer: For small things 👋👋 reads as too loud. Reach for a single emoji; save the combo for moments that genuinely earned the reaction.
